title: Material input and textarea renderer contracts
summary: Input kind and forwarded properties; textarea dimensions, autosize and readonly binding boundaries.

facts.claim: For the Material input renderer, the HTML input kind comes from props.type, falling back to text for a falsy value. The number kind selects a separate template branch whose input type is number.
facts.context: Material input field type input versus props.type HTML text number numeric branch.
limits: This is renderer selection and binding, not a numeric parsing, locale, precision or serialization guarantee. Module aliases and their defaults require separate registration evidence.
facts.source_quote: | input | HTML input kind comes from `props.type`; number has a dedicated template branch. Forwards readonly, required, error matcher, control, attributes, name, placeholder | [K47](sources.md#k47) |

facts.claim: Both Material input template branches bind readonly from props.readonly, required from required, placeholder from props.placeholder and tabIndex from props.tabindex. They also bind formControl, errorStateMatcher and formlyAttributes; name comes from field.name.
facts.context: Material input readonly required placeholder tabindex errorStateMatcher formControl attributes name forwarding.
limits: These are the inspected renderer bindings, not proof that every raw HTML or Material input property is forwarded. A readonly binding does not establish disabled-state, validation or payload-exclusion equivalence.
facts.source_quote: | input | HTML input kind comes from `props.type`; number has a dedicated template branch. Forwards readonly, required, error matcher, control, attributes, name, placeholder | [K47](sources.md#k47) |

facts.claim: Material textarea binds rows to props.rows and cols to props.cols. Its default options set both rows and cols to 1.
facts.context: Material textarea rows cols default dimensions height width.
limits: These are attribute bindings and defaults, not a guaranteed pixel size or fixed height under all CSS and autosize configurations.
facts.source_quote: | textarea | Adds rows/cols and autosize/min/max rows; readonly is explicitly bound. Default rows and cols are 1 | [K51](sources.md#k51) |

facts.claim: Material textarea binds cdkTextareaAutosize to props.autosize, cdkAutosizeMinRows to props.autosizeMinRows and cdkAutosizeMaxRows to props.autosizeMaxRows. Its cdk-textarea-autosize class is also controlled by props.autosize.
facts.context: Material textarea autosize autosizeMinRows autosizeMaxRows grow shrink row limits CDK bindings.
limits: The source establishes forwarding, not a guarantee of resizing timing, hidden-container measurement, validation of conflicting bounds or compatibility with every CDK release. It does not establish that rows alone enables autosize.
facts.source_quote: | textarea | Adds rows/cols and autosize/min/max rows; readonly is explicitly bound. Default rows and cols are 1 | [K51](sources.md#k51) |

facts.claim: Material textarea binds readonly from props.readonly, required from required, placeholder from props.placeholder and tabindex from props.tabindex, alongside formControl, errorStateMatcher and formlyAttributes; name comes from field.name.
facts.context: Material textarea readonly required placeholder tabindex control validation error matcher attributes forwarding.
limits: This does not make readonly interchangeable with disabling a form control or establish payload exclusion. Renderer source alone does not establish universal browser, hydration or application validation behavior.
